assets.name: badge
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Separate an existing illustration for use as a transparent web asset. Only isolate the FIRST card's translucent lavender scalloped rosette with saturated purple star, the two diagonal rays and its small lavender sparkle accents. Match the reference EXACTLY in shapes, color, lighting, relative proportions and orientation. No redesign. Remove all text, all card background and other card content. The result is just this object group on TRUE TRANSPARENT background with a subtle object shadow, centered, with only minimal 5% transparent padding so it can fill a left-hand web card illustration. No checkerboard, no white background, no letters, no numbers, no new objects. Preserve the glossy soft-3D style. Square 1024x1024.
